report_topic: Planning and Contract Management of Road Works in Public Works Department
observations_summary: The audit revealed significant deficiencies in planning, cost estimation, and contract management of road works, leading to avoidable excess expenditure of ₹38.63 crore and inordinate delays in completion for 203 projects. Issues included lack of periodical planning, restrictive tender conditions limiting competition, and payments of ₹1,480.37 crore to contractors without ensuring quality control measures.
